news.title: GCA Launcher 3.0 Preview Tour
news.summary: Explore a modernized single screen launcher by GocalSD.
news.content: We are thrilled to announce GCA Launcher 3.0 Open Beta! I will officially launch GCA v3 in 2027 with a subscription model to pro features. If you havn't been keeping an eye on my social feed, get caught up on whats new in GCA with this tour I provided on Youtube.

news.title: GCA v3 Test Video
news.summary: View a test session of GCA v3
news.content: This was one of my first visual test videos coming out to the public for GCA v3. We show off some of the homescreen interactions and Groups 2.0

news.title: New Update Available
news.summary: Another beta update is now live
news.content: This evening, I published several updates and the final one of the night seems to be the cake. I addressed several issues with the application database, some broken issues in the homescreen dock, fixed the popup listener for dock apps and some app breaking issues caused by the database. I will be working to improve the database logging and execution in the background so we can track issues better in the future. The maintenance section will be revised here soon so keep an eye out. Alot of these trackers will need your permission to be enabled first but be mindful this data is yours unless you share it to me. There is no way for me to access it unless you send it to me. Again, thank you everyone who has helped me button up a few things week.

news.title: Recent App Management
news.summary: Did you know GCA Launcher has a built in app ops?
news.content: GCA Launcher does a great job at recent application managment but it also helps you determine which apps aren't needed or used anymore. Take advantage of the suggestions it gives you! It also offers focus hours. Disable distracting apps at night or at work.
